title: Finding Help Online
drDigitalIntro:
When a problem persists after force-quitting and restarting, the internet is your best next step.
• Error codes are your friend: an error like 'PX-4402' or 'Error 0x80070005' looks scary but is specific — copy it exactly and paste it into a support site or search engine.
• Official support sites (the company's own website) give the most reliable answers. Search '[app name] support [error code]' to find them.
• When to ask a person: strange sounds or smells, a screen that stays black, a suspected virus, or when you have tried everything and nothing works.
• Before calling support, write down: the error message, what you were doing when it happened, and what you have already tried. This saves time.
• You are not alone — millions of people see the same error messages. Someone has already written the fix.

playgroundTask.goal: You found a solution by copying the error code and searching for it
playgroundTask.scenario: Photos shows an error with code PX-4402

steps.say: Photos crashed with error PX-4402. Copy the error code — you will need it.
Click OK to close the error dialog.
Open Browser from the dock to search for help.
Click Paste to put the error code into the support search box.
Click Submit to find a solution.
The solution says to reopen Photos. Click Photos in the dock.

drDigitalSuccess: You copied the exact error and searched for it. Anybody helping you, paid or not, can do far more with the exact words than with "it broke".
drDigitalHint: Copy the error code, close the dialog, open Browser, paste the code, submit, then reopen Photos.
